nodes.label: Cross-platform support (Linux/macOS/Windows)
nodes.rationale: Pure Python 3.12+ (pathlib, no platform syscalls, no symlink/chmod reliance); WSL2 recommended on Windows; planned CI matrix and a Python selfcheck runner.

nodes.label: MPI launcher & oversubscribe handling
nodes.rationale: mpirun by default, VASP_AUTO_MPI overrides it (mpiexec for MS-MPI/Intel). Open MPI counts physical cores as slots, so the runner adds --use-hwthread-cpus when ranks fit hardware threads or --oversubscribe when they exceed them; these flags are OpenMPI-specific and skipped for Intel/MS-MPI.
